listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference (self-citation) to energy/exergy analysis of a submerged arc furnace for ferrochrome production — continuous primary-metals processing, but only cited, not the paper's own application context
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Energy and exergy analyses of a submerged arc furnace used for ferrochrome
production. Int. J. Exergy 2024, 44, 89–106.
listed_sector_signals.sector: steel and other primary-metals continuous production

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: The study plant is described as a continuously operating factory, though the industry type (product/process) is never specified and no continuous-flow production sector is named
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Identifying leaks in a continuously operating factory environment is
challenging because the acoustics emitted by leaks interfere with production noise, making
detection nearly impossible.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Statement that the compressed air system operates continuously year-round — refers to the CAS utility, not to a named continuous-flow production process
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote: systems operate continuously throughout the year, whether loaded or unloaded.

one_line: The paper empirically studies compressed-air-leak energy losses and machine-learning leak-flow prediction in an unspecified manufacturing plant's compressed air (utility) system; the plant's production sector is never identified and no registered continuous-flow sector is the application context.
